sprints.name: Sprint 1
sprints.goal: Working core: log in by role, admin sets up users/courses/sessions, faculty marks attendance manually, student sees their dashboard.

sprints.name: Sprint 2
sprints.goal: Complete release 1.0: QR check-in, corrections, leave, alerts, reports, audit log, policies, and the non-functional checks.

items.title: Project scaffolding: React SPA, Express API, PostgreSQL + Redis via Docker Compose
items.story: As a developer, I want a runnable skeleton of the frontend, API and databases so that the team can build features in parallel.
ac: `docker compose up` starts the client, API, PostgreSQL 15 and Redis 7
API exposes GET /api/v1/health returning 200
Server-side request validation middleware and parameterised DB access are in place (SR-08)
README explains how to run the project locally

items.title: GitHub Actions CI: lint and test on every pull request
items.story: As a team, we want every PR checked automatically so that broken code is not merged.
ac: Workflow runs on push and pull_request to main
Lint and unit tests run for client and server
main is protected: PRs need a passing check and one review before merge

items.title: Database schema and migrations
items.story: As a developer, I want the data model from the SADS as versioned migrations so that every environment has the same schema.
ac: Tables for users, courses, sections, enrolments, sessions, attendance, leave, corrections, audit_log, policies
Attendance percentage view matches SADS §8.2
Application DB role has INSERT but not UPDATE/DELETE on audit_log (SR-06)
Seed script creates demo Admin, Faculty and Student accounts

items.title: User authentication and role-based access
items.story: As a user, I want to log in with my institution email so that I only see the features for my role (Admin, Faculty or Student).
ac: Valid login returns an access token with the user's role and opens the right dashboard
5 failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes (HTTP 423)
Access tokens expire after 15 min; refresh tokens are HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies
Every login attempt is written to the audit log

items.title: Password reset
items.story: As a user who forgot my password, I want a reset link by email so that I can regain access securely.
ac: Same response whether or not the email exists
Links are single-use and expire after 15 minutes
All existing sessions are revoked after a successful reset

items.title: User management with bulk CSV import
items.story: As an Admin, I want to create, update and deactivate users individually or via CSV so that I can onboard a whole batch quickly.
ac: CSV up to 5,000 rows; invalid rows rejected individually with row number and reason, valid rows still imported
Deactivated users cannot log in; their attendance history is kept

items.title: Course, section and enrolment management
items.story: As an Admin, I want to set up courses and sections, assign faculty and enrol students so that each section has a correct roster.
ac: A student cannot be enrolled twice in the same course in the same semester
Roster changes apply to all sessions scheduled after the change

items.title: Class session scheduling from timetable
items.story: As an Admin or Faculty, I want sessions generated from the weekly timetable so that attendance can be taken for each class.
ac: Sessions generated between semester start and end, skipping holidays
Faculty can add an extra session or cancel one with a reason
Cancelled sessions are excluded from attendance percentage

items.title: Manual attendance marking
items.story: As a Faculty member, I want a roster defaulted to PRESENT that I can adjust and submit in one action so that taking attendance takes under a minute.
ac: Statuses PRESENT, ABSENT, LATE; whole roster saved in one transaction
Allowed from session start until 23:59 the same day
Only faculty assigned to the section can mark it (others get 403)
One ATTENDANCE_MARKED audit entry per submission

items.title: Student attendance dashboard
items.story: As a Student, I want to see my attendance per course and how many more classes I can miss so that I stay above the threshold.
ac: Percentage = (PRESENT + LATE + EXCUSED) ÷ (held − cancelled) × 100, one decimal place
Can-still-miss = floor(attended ÷ threshold − held), minimum 0
A student can see only their own records

items.title: QR-code self check-in with rotating tokens
items.story: As a Faculty member, I want to show a rotating QR code that enrolled students scan so that attendance is fast and proxies are hard.
ac: Faculty opens a 1–10 minute window; QR rotates every 30 s
Tokens are HMAC-SHA256 signed with session ID, nonce and expiry
Expired → QR_EXPIRED, repeat → DUPLICATE_CHECKIN, not enrolled → NOT_ENROLLED, tampered → INVALID_TOKEN
Faculty can override any QR mark manually

items.title: Attendance correction with admin approval
items.story: As a Faculty member, I want to fix a wrong mark, and request approval once the edit window has passed, so that records stay accurate and accountable.
ac: Direct edits allowed within the edit window (default 48 h)
After the window, a correction request with reason needs Admin approval
Every change logs old value, new value, actor, time and reason

items.title: Leave / excused absence requests
items.story: As a Student, I want to submit a leave request with a supporting document so that approved absences count as EXCUSED.
ac: Date range at most 30 days in the past; optional PDF/JPG/PNG up to 5 MB (checked by content)
On approval, ABSENT records in the range become EXCUSED
Student notified by email and in-app within 5 minutes

items.title: Low-attendance alerts
items.story: As a Student, I want to be warned when I drop below the threshold so that I can act before exams.
ac: Alert within 15 minutes of the record that caused the drop (default threshold 75%)
At most one alert per course every 7 days
Faculty can list students below threshold for their sections

items.title: Reports and CSV/PDF export
items.story: As Faculty or Admin, I want attendance reports I can export so that eligibility decisions use reliable data.
ac: Reports by section, course, student or department over a date range
Faculty limited to their own sections; Admin sees all
Exported CSV/PDF figures match the on-screen report exactly

items.title: Audit log viewer (read-only)
items.story: As an Admin, I want to search the audit log so that I can trace any sensitive change.
ac: Filter by actor, action, entity and date range; paginated
DELETE/PATCH on audit entries return 405; DB-level UPDATE is denied

items.title: Attendance policy configuration
items.story: As an Admin, I want to configure the threshold, edit window, QR window and holidays so that the system matches institution rules.
ac: Threshold 50–100%, edit window 0–168 h; out-of-range values rejected
Every configuration change is audit-logged

items.title: Performance and burst-load testing
items.story: As a team, we want load tests on the API so that we know it meets the response-time targets, including the QR check-in burst.
ac: At 500 concurrent users, p95 ≤ 2 s and p99 ≤ 4 s
QR check-in burst test passes the NFR-02 target
Load-test script and results committed to the repo

items.title: Deployment, health checks and backup/restore
items.story: As an operator, I want health checks, auto-restart and tested backups so that the system recovers from failures.
ac: Containers restart automatically on failure; health endpoint monitored
Database backup script plus one documented restore drill

items.title: Usability, accessibility and browser compatibility
items.story: As any user, I want the app to work on my phone or laptop and with a keyboard so that everyone can use it.
ac: No WCAG 2.1 AA violations from axe-core on key pages
Marking can be completed keyboard-only
Layout works at 360 px and 1920 px on Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge

items.title: Data retention job
items.story: As the institution, we want old data purged on schedule so that we comply with the retention policy.
ac: Scheduled job implements the NFR-09 retention rules
Audit entries kept for 3 years
